title: Chapter 266 Purpose
content:
Chapter 266 Purpose

Everyone's speculation didn't last long, and soon with the arrival of the convoy, the answer was announced in front of them.

"Master Chen Lin, you have come from a long way, but you couldn't go out of the city to meet him, you are really rude and negligent!" Far away, when the convoy stopped 50 meters away from the city gate, Han An summoned his deep internal strength and moved towards the owner of the convoy. Greetings.

"Where, I am flattered that the general can come to welcome you!" The one who spoke was the person in charge of the convoy, who is now the Minister of Rites of the Imperial Kingdom, the well-known Chen Lin in the Three Kingdoms world.

Chen Lin is well-known throughout the Three Kingdoms for her outstanding literary talent and eloquence, and her name will remain in history. He once had a very classic allusion, that is, during the Battle of Guandu, there was a custom at that time. That is, when the two armies are at war, they will often publish a call to declare the justice of their own side and the evil of the enemy, and it is also a harbinger of the beginning of the war.

And Chen Lin wrote such an essay, the literary talent is quite good, it can be said that every word is pearls, it is sobering. It is said that when Cao Cao saw this essay, he was suffering from a headache, and he was frightened by the content of the essay on the spot, and his headache healed without any medicine.

This shows how outstanding his literary talent and eloquence are!

Now, because of his literary talent and eloquence, he has been promoted to the Ministry of Rites as a servant. This is an official of the fourth rank, and in the entire imperial kingdom, he can be regarded as entering the top city in the center.

Now, it is because of his characteristics that he has been appointed to an important task. Going to South Korea as an envoy, marrying his daughter Princess Honglian to the King of Han, and welcoming her to Yuguo as the first concubine of his emperor, that is, the first woman.

This is a great honor.

In the entire imperial kingdom, from the civil and military officials to the local people, everyone is worried about the heirs of his emperor. Now His Majesty the Emperor finally changed his mind and began to get close to women, wanting to accept concubines.

If such an important change is completed by Chen Lin, then he will definitely be promoted to a noble because of his achievements, and he will leave a strong mark in the entire history of the imperial kingdom.

I'm afraid that those generals who have made great achievements in fighting the country and ministers who have managed the country well, no matter how great their contributions are, they can't compare with him, the envoy who facilitated the emperor's marriage.

After all, the continuation of offspring is related to the continuation and stability of a country, and it is the foundation of a country, which cannot be ignored.

Thinking of this, Chen Lin, who was being courteous with Han An, couldn't help but feel even more joyful. The unstoppable smile made Han An feel strange.

The convoy left the gate of the city quickly, and was welcomed by Han An to the state guesthouse where the envoy was received, where they rested.

In fact, Han Wang had not heard any news about Chen Lin's mission this time, and he was not very clear about the purpose of the mission.

However, the scale of the accident and the solemnity of the etiquette made Han Wang look sideways.

Among the hundreds of exchanges between South Korea and Yuguo before, the scale was so large, but it was only when they visited South Korea in an accident. Other than that, it was never seen again.

So, even though King Han didn't know what the envoy's purpose was this time, he still carefully sent his confidant, that is, Han An, who was called his shadow by others, to meet him. , others can't find anything wrong with it.

As for letting King Han greet him in person, that is a joke. Before welcoming King Jing, both of them have the same level of status as kings, so there is nothing wrong with it. But to welcome an envoy is to lose his identity, not to mention his own face, but also South Korea's face.

...

The next day, the South Korean government hall.

Today's Korean civil and military officials are surprisingly ready in time, and none of them is absent. There are usually so many people here, but that time it was not an annual festival, or a meeting about the rise and fall of South Korea's fate.

But now, it is neither an important day nor a time of war, it is really strange that all these courtiers are concentrated.

There is no other purpose for them to come. There is only one real reason, and that is the envoy of Yu Kingdom this time, Chen Lin.

"Hanwang Highness, I greet you on behalf of His Majesty the Emperor Liguo!" Chen Lin was full of confidence, with a kind smile on her face, and she was dressed in the high-ranking official costume of Yuguo, which gave her her own style.

The surrounding South Korean officials frequently looked sideways at this extremely young, but nearly thirty-year-old imperial envoy in front of him, with a handsome appearance, gentle and elegant, full of bookishness. Such graceful and graceful, can't help secretly heartbroken.

Among other things, they don't know the talent of the person in front of them, but this appearance alone is enough to shame many people in the court.

"It's worthy of coming from a big country, and the bearing is really extraordinary!" This was the thought of many South Korean officials present.

Han Wang was also impressed by Chen Lin's temperament, and was taken aback for a moment. But after all, he is a king, and he has seen many people, and it is not like he has never seen someone like Chen Lin, so he quickly came to his senses: "The envoy also greets the lord of your country on behalf of the lonely king!"

"I don't know what's the important thing for the messenger to come here?" Han Wang finished his greetings, and quickly continued to ask.

Not only the ministers are very curious about this trip to South Korea, but also King Han.

In fact, people like Han Wang had many guesses in their hearts, but it was difficult to be sure, and many of them were vetoed by themselves.

After guessing and guessing, there is only one guess that is more reliable, and that is that this mission should be an announcement of an action against the goal of the alliance!

But if it is just to declare a goal, a small mission with dozens of people is enough. How can we use such a large convoy of thousands of people, which can almost catch up with an army, and they are all elites composed of some martial arts masters army.

Therefore, the King of Han and even the whole of South Korea were puzzled.

"Your Highness, the foreign ministers have no purpose in coming here this time. They only ask for one thing, which is to benefit our two countries, and to make the exchanges between our two countries more in-depth and closer!"

Standing in the center of the hall, Chen Lin heard the impatient inquiry, a smile appeared on her face, and she replied loudly.

"The communication is deeper and closer. What's the matter? The envoy, don't be tricky, tell me quickly!" Han Wang chewed softly, but couldn't figure out what happened, so he hurriedly asked.

"My Majesty the Great Yu Emperor has reached the age of his thirties, but the harem has been empty for a long time without a single concubine! This has to be said to be a great pity for my imperial country, but His Majesty pursues the way of refining Qi and longevity, and is not close to women. , let us be in a difficult situation but there is nothing we can do! But God is sorry, now under the persuasion of the ministers, His Majesty finally agrees to accept concubines, fill the harem, give birth to offspring, and inherit the country. Among them, there is one who can be the imperial concubine!" Chen Lin was full of excitement, and said a long sentence in one go, as if to relieve the worries in his heart.

"Oh, it's unbelievable that such a thing happened!" Han Wang said thoughtfully with a flash of light in his eyes.
